ai.headline: Steam adds rules banning automation tools and bots, and expands cheating rules
ai.summary: Steam's terms now have a new section banning scripts, bots, and other automated systems from interacting with Steam content and services, including faking gameplay stats and earning rewards without genuine input. Users are also barred from using their account to enable others' violations, and Steam says it may enforce these rules with automated detection and human review. Valve can restrict or terminate accounts for automation, and it no longer says that conduct "illegal" is grounds for action in the cheating section, and the EU/UK dispute-resolution and court-venue language was removed.
